title: ArtemisTwin provisional analog screening model
notes: Analog Fit is a weighted similarity between documented Earth measurements and a declared target envelope, 0–100.
It is not a match, a safety rating, an operational ranking, or evidence that a site can substitute for the Moon or Mars.
Absolute elevation is not compared across bodies; L1 uses local relief inside the same footprint.
Pressure is excluded from the fit for Moon and Mars targets because Earth surface sites cannot reproduce it.
Layers marked proxy receive half weight. Missing layers are never imputed as zero; they lower Data Completeness.
The uncertainty band propagates measurement, envelope and weight uncertainty only. It does not cover unmeasured conditions; a separate missing-data sensitivity range is reported.

layer_registry.basis: Local relief (max − min) inside the 2 × 2 km footprint; absolute elevation kept as context only.
Mean slope over the footprint at the sampled grid.
Terrain Ruggedness Index, dimensionless (metres of neighbour difference per cell metre).

layer_registry.earth_source: NASA POWER Earth skin temperature (TS) climatology
layer_registry.basis: Warmest monthly climatological skin temperature. Air temperature is not surface temperature; flagged as a proxy.

layer_registry.earth_source: NASA POWER Earth skin temperature (TS) climatology
layer_registry.basis: Coldest monthly climatological skin temperature; proxy for surface radiant temperature.
Annual mean all-sky shortwave downward irradiance, converted from kWh/m²/day.
Reported for context. Excluded from the fit because no Earth surface site reproduces a lunar vacuum or the ~0.6 kPa Martian atmosphere.

layer_registry.earth_source: Not acquired (SMAP / MODIS snow not wired in this build)
layer_registry.basis: Water-equivalent percentage. No Earth value in this build; shown as a named gap.

layer_registry.earth_source: Not acquired (EMIT / ASTER not wired in this build)
layer_registry.basis: Normalised spectral index. No Earth value in this build; shown as a named gap.
Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm mapped to 0–1 by min(1, AOD/0.8). A haze proxy, not a regolith-abrasion measurement.

layer_registry.earth_source: Not acquired (needs field survey or high-resolution imagery)
layer_registry.basis: Percent rock cover. No Earth value in this build; shown as a named gap.

layer_registry.earth_source: Not acquired (OSM cave entrances not queried)
layer_registry.basis: Distance to nearest documented cave or lava-tube entrance. No Earth value in this build.
Context column only; weight 0 in every purpose so logistics never moves the fit score.

purposes.question: Can a wheeled rover climb and cross this kind of terrain?
Can instruments that look for ice be tested in comparable cold and frozen ground?
Do temperatures swing far enough to test habitat insulation and heating?
Are there caves or lava tubes with comparable rock for robots to explore?

earth_limits.label: Gravity
earth_limits.why_it_matters: Loads, traction, dust settling and rover dynamics differ. No Earth surface site changes this.

earth_limits.label: Surface pressure / vacuum
earth_limits.why_it_matters: Outgassing, convection, dust lifting and suit/rover sealing cannot be rehearsed in the open at an Earth site.

earth_limits.label: Space radiation
earth_limits.earth: Atmosphere and magnetosphere attenuate most of it
earth_limits.why_it_matters: Surface radiation exposure is not reproduced; use the NASA Space Radiation Laboratory or flight opportunities instead.

earth_limits.label: True polar lighting
earth_limits.earth: 24 h day cycle and atmospheric scattering
earth_limits.moon: Long shadows, low Sun, permanently shadowed regions
earth_limits.why_it_matters: Illumination geometry and shadow behaviour differ even when mean irradiance is similar.

earth_limits.label: Regolith & dust
earth_limits.earth: Weathering, water and biology change surface materials
earth_limits.why_it_matters: Abrasion, adhesion and dust-storm behaviour are not reproduced by Earth soils or desert dust.

formula.fit: 100 * Σ(effective_weight_i * s_i) / Σ(effective_weight_i), over available non-excluded layers
formula.confidence_band: 10th–90th percentile of the Monte Carlo fit distribution

limits: Fit depends on analyst-set target envelopes and purpose weights; a different envelope changes the score.
The band does not include unmeasured conditions; read the missing-data sensitivity separately.
60/100 is not a pass mark. There is no validated threshold for mission relevance.
